index.html.title: Dashboard
index.html.lede: A clear hiring plan for a stuck concealed mechanism: compare the scopes, review licensed candidates, and keep every unknown visible.

items.s: Different scopes · not comparable all-in bids

sections.html: Best documented starting point: General SF. Its business pages advertise both plumbing and sheetrock/tape/texture, and CSLB lists B + C-36. This is a conditional first inquiry, not a confirmed hire: crew coverage, exact extraction ability and a combined price remain unverified. Compare all nine candidates →

items.d: Decision, key risks and next steps
Reasons, official links, phones and costs
Scope comparison and blank verified values

sections.html: Blank cells mean unverified, not zero or no. Business websites are official sources for their own statements; CSLB is the authority for license facts. Owner estimates are transcribed separately. See exactly what was checked.

summary.html.title: Executive summary
summary.html.lede: What is known, what is not, and the most defensible next hiring decision.

sections.title: Decision
sections.html: Start with General SF, then Handyman Heroes and Rapid Flow: each advertises plumbing and drywall-related services and has B + C-36 on its CSLB record. General SF has the clearest sheetrock/tape/texture wording; Handyman Heroes adds documented patch/texture/cleanup services and a workers' compensation policy, but also an official citation disclosure. This order is conditional on a satisfactory site-specific proposal, not evidence that any firm can extract this particular mechanism.

sections.title: Cost conclusion
sections.html: The owner reports $614 for Expert Plumbing Solutions' waste-and-overflow replacement, $550 for Bay Area Plumbing's lever/plug/spout-with-diverter work, and $135 for Fast Response's repair/adjustment. These are owner-provided figures, not verified prices. They describe different scopes; drywall inclusion was not stated. No all-in total, cheapest-option claim or savings estimate is justified. Verified amount cells remain blank.

sections.title: Access and occupied-unit plan
sections.html: Preserve the preference for a conservative above-access assessment, but do not assume it is feasible. Watco documents plate/linkage adjustment on example products; Oatey describes inspecting concealed joints during a replacement test. The installed model, cause of seizure, framing and ceiling rating are unknown. Request one coordinated proposal with separate diagnostic, contingent below-access, plumbing, protection, testing and restoration items. Confirm tenant scheduling, dust containment and cleanup before authorizing work.

sections.title: Important cautions
sections.html: Four shortlisted records show workers' compensation exemptions. Handyman Heroes has a disclosure and a website C-10 claim not on its reviewed license. Fast Response has an address discrepancy and a policy expiring in December 2026. Yelp direct fetches were blocked, so current ratings/counts play no role in the ranking. No provider has been contacted or accepted the work.

sections.title: What a complete proposal should contain
Official rules and evidence
sections.html: SF DBI requires a permit before cutting/replacing pipes subject to code exemptions; minor wallboard repair guidance does not decide the plumbing scope. License classifications and incidental-work rules do not establish this job's coverage. See Official rules, Source ledger and Flagged for review. This dashboard is procurement analysis, not a code determination or engineering instruction.

sections.html: Do not add the three quotes together or choose the lowest as the best repair. First normalize the component, access method, testing, ceiling restoration, protection and finish scope.

sections.title: How the order was decided
sections.html: First priority: documented plumbing plus drywall services in SF. Next: official license classes and workers' compensation evidence, then disclosed irregularities. The three owner-quoted plumbers remain useful plumbing options but have less verified combined-service evidence. No numerical score is fabricated from blocked reviews, and a broader license list is not treated as proof of better workmanship.
